blurb: This check verifies that every AIX global initialization file (/etc/profile, /etc/environment, /etc/security/environ, /etc/security/.profile, /etc/csh.login, /etc/csh.cshrc) contains the "mesg n" (or "mesg -n") command and that none contains the "mesg y" command, so users are denied write access to the terminal and another user cannot write to or capture an active session.
